_doc: newLeaves paths follow the Option A regroup (mod menu-a, 2026-10-12: Helpers became part of Misc). What the branches merged with menu-layout on 2026-10-08 (mod 3744aa32) changed on purpose, on top of the menu-layout-<variant>.json fixtures (recorded from 6a61dfa8). 511: goneLeaves must be absent, newLeaves must be at exactly that path once. 513: a fixture row listed in tooltips must now show "text" (under "to" when it moved sub-tab) or be gone everywhere ("gone"); an entry that no longer differs from the fixture is stale and fails.

tooltips.text: In the Croesus menu, marks each run by what is left in it. Runs that need you stand out: unclaimed (solid orange) and worth going back to with a Dungeon Chest Key (solid magenta with a key mark). Runs with nothing to do are outlines or a light tint, no fill: not looked at yet (a muted teal outline), opened with nothing worth a key (a muted blue outline) and done with a key (a light dark tint). Drawn behind the items, under their tooltips; the key mark sits over the item.
tooltips.why: croesus-ui 79dd7ecc / croesus-key: Highlight Runs behind the items, then by chest-key state (killer560, 2026-10-12); croesus-colors 2026-10-12: magenta / cyan / blue-border palette; croesus-colors2 2026-10-13: action states solid, quiet states recede, no "?" mark; croesus-outline 5802c253 2026-10-13: muted teal/blue full outlines
